title: AI Skill Toolkit SKILL.md frontmatter
description: Strict frontmatter schema for SKILL.md. 'name' is the dispatcher slug (kebab-case, equals folder/id). 'displayName' is the human-readable label. triggers.positive MUST be a superset of the matching manifest entry's primary_when.

name.description: Dispatcher slug. MUST be kebab-case and MUST equal both 'id' and the parent folder name.

displayName.description: Human-readable label shown in UIs (optional). Example: 'API Design'.

description.description: Activation summary used by skill dispatchers. Should contain trigger phrases and (when relevant) skip conditions; offload long enumerations to `triggers.positive`.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier. MUST equal 'name' and the parent folder name.

category.description: Top-level grouping used for routing and conflict resolution.

version.description: Semver of this skill definition. 0.x = preview, >=1.0.0 = stable.

positive.description: Phrases or keywords that should activate this skill. MUST be a superset of the matching manifest entry's primary_when.

negative.description: Phrases or keywords that should suppress activation, even if positive triggers also match.

triggers.description: Bidirectional trigger model. Dispatchers should activate only when at least one positive trigger matches AND no negative trigger matches.

mcp.description: MCP servers the skill depends on (e.g. firecrawl, exa, context7). The skill should fail gracefully if any are missing.

os.description: Supported operating systems. Omit this field to mean all OSes — do NOT redundantly list [windows, macos, linux].

bin.description: External executables required on PATH (e.g. python3, node, git).

requires.description: Hard dependencies. The validator does not check actual availability; it only checks the declaration shape.

allOf.description: id MUST equal name (enforced by validator at cross-field check time).
